verdict.rationale: The evidence documents only Devin's own MCP server, which exposes Devin's sessions, playbooks, knowledge, and scheduling to other MCP-compatible agents. That is the server role and does not show Devin connecting to external MCP servers as a client to use their tools. No evidence item shows MCP-client configuration or a marketplace in Devin, its CLI, or Desktop.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
